h1: BMW Diesel Timing Chain Repair (N47 / B47)
lede: N47 and B47 diesel engines have the timing chain mounted at the rear of the engine, between the block and the gearbox. This design makes replacement a specialist, engine-out procedure — not a simple front-end job.

blocks.html: N47 and B47 diesel engines have the timing chain mounted at the rear of the engine, between the block and the gearbox. This design makes replacement a specialist, engine-out procedure — not a simple front-end job.

We carry out the full BMW-specified repair: engine removal, timing locking, complete replacement of the chain, guides, and tensioners with updated parts, and reassembly with verified timing. The transmission is separated, the cylinder head and sump are removed for access, and every critical component is inspected and replaced where needed. This is the same procedure BMW service bulletins (SI B11 09 07, SI B11 03 13) describe as the only proper repair for chain stretch or failure.
We do not use split-chain or in-situ methods. A proper repair requires new guides and tensioners, not just a new chain — and that requires engine removal.
This repair applies to BMW models equipped with the N47 or B47 diesel engine family — pre-2015 N47 engines (rear-mounted chain) and post-2015 B47 engines (EGR cooler recall applies separately).

steps.title: Inspection & Confirmation
steps.body: We inspect the engine to confirm chain wear and rule out other causes of noise or warning lights.

steps.title: Engine Removal
steps.body: Complete engine-out extraction to access the rear timing chain area — transmission separated, ancillaries removed.

steps.title: Strip-Down & Timing Lock
steps.body: Cylinder head and sump removed, timing tools lock camshafts and crankshaft in the correct position.

steps.title: Chain, Guides & Tensioner Replacement
steps.body: Old components removed; new updated BMW guides, tensioner, and chain fitted.

steps.title: Reassembly & Timing Verification
steps.body: All components reassembled, timing verified with specialist tools, engine refitted and tested.

items.q: What are the symptoms of a failing timing chain on an N47 or B47 engine?
items.a: Rattle on cold start, or a persistent rattling from the rear of the engine, especially at low revs. In later stages, the engine management light may illuminate or the car may go into limp mode. We inspect and confirm the condition before any work begins.

items.q: How long does the repair take?
items.a: The full engine-out procedure typically takes 3–5 working days, depending on the model and the condition of the engine when it arrives.

items.q: Do you fit used or aftermarket parts?
items.a: We fit new, BMW-specified or equivalent-quality chain kits, guides, and tensioners. We do not use split-chain links or used parts.

The fixed-price quote includes engine removal, new chain, guides, tensioners, gaskets, seals, oil and filter, timing tools, and reassembly. It excludes any additional work identified during strip-down (e.g. failed injectors, turbo issues). We quote transparently for any extra work.
12 months unlimited mileage on the rebuild, covering parts and labour.
